## ✨ Features

### Media Files

5 fonts, 6 textures and 8 sound effects.

### Item

1. **Delete Item**: Automatically fill "DELETE" text when deleting items; supports click-to-confirm and delete key; customizable confirm button style.
2. **Already Known**: Add colored overlay to recipes, toys, pets, and mounts you already know; supports custom colors and opacity; works in bags, mailbox, and merchant frames.
3. **Fast Loot**: Enhance auto-loot speed for more efficient looting.
4. **Trade**: One-click thank you button on trade frame to express appreciation.
5. **Extra Item Bar**: Customizable item bars for flasks, potions, quest items, and custom items; supports up to 5 bars with configurable size, spacing, backdrop, and item slots; auto-show/hide based on content; keybind support.
6. **Contacts**: Add contact list panel beside mailbox with favorites and quick mail sending.
7. **Inspect**: Add equipment list panel beside character and inspect frames showing all slots; displays item level, gem info, and enchants;
8. **Extended Merchant Pages**: Extend merchant frame to display more items per page for faster browsing.

### Combat

1. **Raid Markers**: Add customizable raid marker bar with world markers, skull/cross markers, ready check, pull countdown, and clear markers; supports button size, spacing, backdrop, keybinds, and visibility options (party/raid/solo).
2. **Combat Alert**: Display customizable animations and screen effects when entering/leaving combat; adjust size, speed, and color.
3. **Quick Keystone**: Automatically place Mythic Keystone from bags into font when the UI opens.

### Map

1. **Super Tracker**: Additional features for waypoint - auto track, middle click to clear, remove distance limitation, waypoint parse support, virtual TomTom command support.
2. **Rectangle Minimap**: Customize the minimap with different length of width and height.
3. **Minimap Buttons**: Collect all minimap buttons to a bar with customizable layout, sorting priority, and expansion buttons support.
4. **World Map**: Remove fog of war with optional colored fog; resize world map with custom scale.
5. **Instance Difficulty**: Reskin the instance difficulty in text style with customizable font and strings.
6. **Event Tracker**: Track world events in the world map - supports TWW weekly quests, Nightfall, Theater Troupe, Radiant Echoes, Dragonlands events with customizable alerts and sounds.

### Quest

1. **Objective Tracker**: Customize fonts, colors, and add cosmetic bars to quest headers; supports colorful progress text, percentage display, and custom backdrop.
2. **Turn In**: Automatically accept and complete quests with smart reward selection, customizable pause modifiers, and smart NPC chat support (Darkmoon Faire, Follower Assignees); includes NPC ignore list.
3. **Switch Buttons**: Add a customizable bar with buttons for quickly toggling Turn In and Announcement modules.

### Social

1. **Chat Bar**: Add customizable channel switching bar with support for world channels, community channels, emote panel, and roll buttons; supports horizontal/vertical orientation, auto-hide, mouseover, block/text styles, and custom button sizes.
2. **Chat Link**: Enhance item links with icons, level, numerical quality tier, armor/weapon categories, and item name translation; customizable icon sizes.
3. **Chat Text**: Customize role icon packs (8 styles: FFXIV, PhilMod, Hexagon, ElvUI, SunUI, LynUI, ElvUI Old, Blizzard); remove brackets, realm names; add class/faction icons; enhance guild member status; merge achievements; BNet friend online/offline alerts; custom channel abbreviations.
4. **Context Menu**: Add taint-free context menu options: guild invite, who, report stats, and armory (with region override support); includes styled section titles.
5. **Emote**: Parse and send emotes with customizable icon size; emote panel activated by pressing {; chat bubble support.
6. **Friend List**: Enhance friend list with status icon packs (Default/Diablo 3/Square), game icon styles; add colorful level (with hide max level option), class color, client color; use notes as names; hide realm; custom fonts for name and info.
7. **Smart Tab**: Use Tab to cycle chat channels intelligently; configurable channel inclusion (Yell, Battleground, Raid Warning, Officer); whisper history with adjustable expiration time.

### Announcement

1. **Quest**: Announce detailed quest progress to party members, supports including quest link and progress information; and also better quest progression text display.
2. **Goodbye**: Say goodbye to teammates after dungeon/raid completion with customizable messages and delay.
3. **Reset Instance**: Alert teammates after resetting instances with customizable messages.
4. **Keystone**: Announce Mythic+ keystone information with customizable format.

### Tooltip

1. **General**: Customizable modifier key; add title icons for items, spells, achievements; faction icons; pet icons and IDs; tier set information.
2. **ElvUI Tooltip Tweaks**: Adjust health bar and text Y-offsets; add spec icons and race icons with customizable sizes; enhanced Mythic+ info with dungeon icons; force item level display.
3. **Progression**: Display raid progression, special achievements, and Mythic+ scores with customizable header styles (none/text/texture); supports instance filtering and highest score marking; disable in combat option.
4. **Keystone**: Show keystone information in tooltips (requires both side Details!, BigWigs or WindTools installed); supports abbreviation and custom icon sizes.
5. **Group Info**: Add detailed LFG group information with customizable templates, class icon styles, compact/normal modes; options to exclude dungeons and hide Blizzard default info.
6. **Objective Progress**: Add detailed objective progress information for mobs with adjustable accuracy.

### Unit Frames

1. **Quick Focus**: Set focus to mouseover unit using customizable modifier keys (Alt/Ctrl/Shift) + left/right/middle mouse click combinations; works on all unit frames.
2. **Absorb**: Customize ElvUI absorb bar texture and add Blizzard-style absorb spark to health bar end; customize spark size, color, and offset.
3. **Role Icon**: Change role icon pack (8 styles: FFXIV, PhilMod, Hexagon, ElvUI, SunUI, LynUI, ElvUI Old, Blizzard); applies to all unit frames with role icons.
4. **Tags**: Add custom ElvUI tags including range display, health/power without signs, class colors, and icons.

### Skins

1. **Vignetting**: Add the shadowed border inner game interface.
2. **Blizzard Frame Skins**: Additional skins for Blizzard frames.
3. **ElvUI Frame Skins**: Reskin ElvUI modules.
4. **WindTools Skins**: Reskin WindTools modules.
5. **Ace3 Skins**: Apply ElvUI skin for Ace3-GUI widgets.
6. **Angry Keystones Skin**: Apply skins for Angry Keystones mythic plus timer.
7. **Auctionator Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Auctionator all frames.
8. **BigWigs Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for BigWigs.
9. **BigWigs Queue Timer Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for BigWigs Queue Timer.
10. **BtWQuests Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for BtWQuests.
11. **BugSack Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for BugSack.
12. **Collectionator Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Collectionator.
13. **Immersion Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Immersion.
14. **Manuscripts Journal Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Manuscripts Journal.
15. **Mount Route Planner Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Mount Route Planner.
16. **MultiLanguage Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for MultiLanguage.
17. **Myslot Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Myslot.
18. **Mythic Dungeon Tools Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Mythic Dungeon Tools.
19. **OmniCD Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for OmniCD Config GUI, icons, extra bars, and status bars.
20. **Paragon Reputation Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Paragon Reputation.
21. **Plumber Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Plumber.
22. **Postal Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Postal normal buttons and quick attach buttons.
23. **Premade Groups Filter Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Premade Groups Filter.
24. **RaiderIO Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for RaiderIO.
26. **RareScanner Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for RareScanner.
27. **Rematch Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Rematch.
28. **SilverDragon Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for SilverDragon.
29. **Simple Addon Manager Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Simple Addon Manager.
30. **Simulationcraft Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Simulationcraft.
31. **Talent Loadouts Ex Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for Talent Loadouts Ex.
32. **TinyInspect Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for TinyInspect.
33. **TomCat's Tours Skin**: Reskin the tooltip and header of TomCat's Tours.
34. **TomTom Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for TomTom.
35. **WarpDeplete Skin**: Reskin the bars in WarpDeplete.
36. **WhisperPop Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for WhisperPop.
37. **World Quest Tab Skin**: Apply ElvUI skin for World Quest Tab tabs and settings.

### Misc

1. **CVars Editor**: Simple editor for changing CVars with search, favorites, and reset functionality.
2. **Move Frames**: Move Blizzard frames and ElvUI bags by dragging; remember positions; supports Blizard frames and ElvUI bag frames.
3. **Mute**: Mute annoying sound effects with customizable lists and instant stop all sounds hotkey.
4. **Pause to Slash**: Convert CJK pause symbols (、) to slash (/) for easier slash command input.
5. **Disable Talking Head**: Disable the talking head frame.
7. **Game Bar**: Modern system status bar with customizable buttons (Home, Guild, Friend, Calendar, Volume, System, Mute, Config, Game Menu) positioned left/right; time/latency display; custom fonts, colors, backdrop, and tooltips; supports normal/combat modes with auto-hide.
8. **Skip Cut Scene**: Skip most cutscenes automatically; hold modifier key to watch; option to disable in instances/raids.
9. **LFG List**: Enhance Premade Groups list with class-colored bars, larger class icons, and additional member information.
10. **Move Speed**: Display current movement speed in character panel stats.
11. **Automation**: Auto-accept resurrection, summon, quests; auto-hide frames in combat.
12. **Math Without Kanji**: Replace Chinese/Japanese unit characters with alphabetic characters.
13. **Auto Screenshot**: Automatically screenshot when earning achievements.
14. **Hide Crafter**: Hide crafted by information in item tooltips.
15. **HotKey Above CD**: Display hotkey text above ElvUI cooldown spirals for better visibility.
16. **Guild News Item Level**: Show item level in guild news feed.
17. **Custom Hotkey Alias**: Create custom aliases for key bindings (e.g., change "BUTTON1" to "L").
18. **Exit Phase Diving**: Add a button to quickly exit phased diving areas.
19. **Spell Activation Alert**: Customize position and scale of spell activation alerts (proc overlays).
20. **Reshii Wraps Upgrade**: Middle-click Reshii Wraps to open the upgrade menu.

# Version: 4.25
2026/11/07 Released
## ✳️ New
- [Skins] Added a skin for the WoW Forever group finder (LFGListingFrame). The listing, browse, and who frames and their side tabs get shadows, and the listing texts, buttons, and activity list use the WindTools font style. It uses the Looking For Group toggle.
- [Skins] Added a skin for the Social UI (SocialUIFrame). The main frame, tabs, and side windows get shadows, and the BattleTag, buttons, and list headers use the WindTools font style.
- [Friend List] WoW Forever friend and recent ally cards now use the status icons, game icons, client and class colors, level, location, and fonts. Forever has its own game icon.
- [Extra Items Bar] Added WoW Forever item groups for potions, elixirs, flasks, scrolls, food, bandages, and utilities. These lists load only on WoW Forever. New Forever profiles use them on the item bars.
- [Item Inspect] Added WoW Forever enchant data. It loads only on WoW Forever. The retail enchant data stays on the standard client.
- [Unit Frames] Dispel Overlay now works on WoW Forever party and raid frames.
## 💪 Improvement
- [Skins] The Plumber skin no longer errors on WoW Forever when the expansion landing page is not loaded.
- [Skins] The RaiderIO skin no longer hooks the group finder frame on WoW Forever when that frame is missing.
- [Skins] On WoW Forever, Collections side tabs use the same side-tab skin as other frames. Mount, pet, and toy counts get a backdrop and shadow, and the appearance Items and Sets tabs get a shadow.
- [Fonts] Font updates skip secret justify values from Blizzard frames such as Loss of Control, so they do not taint or error.
- Updated LibRangeCheck-3.0. When the GUID is secret, the cache uses the unit, so range checks work on WoW Forever and Midnight.
- [World Map] Updated the fog removal data for Retail and WoW Forever.
- [Skins] On WoW Forever, the reputation At War, mark inactive, and watch faction checkboxes stay in the character side pane.
- [Skins] On WoW Forever, the character model background is no longer removed.
- [Skins] The Auctionator skin no longer errors after the bug report link was removed.

# 版本: 4.25
2026/11/07 发布
## ✳️ 新增
- [美化外观] 新增 WoW Forever 队伍查找器 (LFGListingFrame) 皮肤. 发布、浏览和查询框体以及侧边标签会加上阴影, 发布页的文字、按钮和活动列表会使用 WindTools 字体样式. 使用 [寻求组队] 开关控制.
- [美化外观] 新增社交界面 (SocialUIFrame) 皮肤. 主框体、标签和侧边窗口会加上阴影, 战网标签、按钮和列表标题会使用 WindTools 字体样式.
- [好友列表] WoW Forever 的好友和近期往来卡片现在会套用状态图标、游戏图标、客户端和职业颜色、等级、位置和字体. Forever 使用单独的游戏图标.
- [额外物品栏] 新增 WoW Forever 物品分组: 药水、药剂、合剂、卷轴、食物、绷带和实用物品. 这些列表只在 WoW Forever 加载. 新的 Forever 配置会在物品栏上使用它们.
- [物品观察] 新增 WoW Forever 附魔数据. 它只在 WoW Forever 加载. 正式服附魔数据仍由标准客户端使用.
- [单位框体] 驱散覆盖现在可以在 WoW Forever 的小队和团队框体上使用.
## 💪 改善
- [美化外观] Plumber 皮肤在 WoW Forever 上不再因为没有资料片登陆页面而报错.
- [美化外观] RaiderIO 皮肤在 WoW Forever 上不再钩选不存在的地下城查找器框体, 避免报错.
- [美化外观] WoW Forever 的藏品侧边标签现在使用和其他界面相同的侧边标签皮肤. 坐骑、宠物和玩具的数量框会加上背景和阴影, 外观的物品和套装标签会加上阴影.
- [字体] 更新字体时会跳过暴雪框体返回的秘密对齐值, 例如失控提示, 避免污染和报错.
- 更新了 LibRangeCheck-3.0. GUID 为秘密值时改用单位做缓存, WoW Forever 和至暗之夜上的距离检测可以正常工作.
- [世界地图] 更新了零售版和 WoW Forever 的迷雾去除数据.
- [美化外观] WoW Forever 角色声望页的交战、标记为未使用和追踪声望复选框会留在侧边栏里.
- [美化外观] WoW Forever 的角色模型背景不再被移除.
- [美化外观] Auctionator 移除错误报告链接后, 皮肤不再因此报错.

------
# 版本: 4.25
2026/11/07 發布
## ✳️ 新增
- [美化外觀] 新增 WoW Forever 隊伍搜尋器 (LFGListingFrame) 皮膚. 發佈、瀏覽和查詢框架以及側邊標籤會加上陰影, 發佈頁的文字、按鈕和活動列表會使用 WindTools 字體樣式. 使用 [尋求組隊] 開關控制.
- [美化外觀] 新增社交介面 (SocialUIFrame) 皮膚. 主框架、標籤和側邊視窗會加上陰影, 戰網標籤、按鈕和列表標題會使用 WindTools 字體樣式.
- [好友名單] WoW Forever 的好友和近期盟友卡片現在會套用狀態圖示、遊戲圖示、客戶端和職業顏色、等級、位置和字體. Forever 使用單獨的遊戲圖示.
- [額外物品條] 新增 WoW Forever 物品分組: 藥水、藥劑、精煉藥劑、卷軸、食物、繃帶和實用物品. 這些列表只在 WoW Forever 載入. 新的 Forever 設定會在物品條上使用它們.
- [物品觀察] 新增 WoW Forever 附魔資料. 它只在 WoW Forever 載入. 正式服附魔資料仍由標準客戶端使用.
- [單位框架] 驅散覆蓋現在可以在 WoW Forever 的小隊和團隊框架上使用.
## 💪 改善
- [美化外觀] Plumber 皮膚在 WoW Forever 上不再因為沒有資料片登陸頁面而報錯.
- [美化外觀] RaiderIO 皮膚在 WoW Forever 上不再勾住不存在的地城搜尋器框架, 避免報錯.
- [美化外觀] WoW Forever 的收藏側邊標籤現在使用和其他介面相同的側邊標籤皮膚. 坐騎、寵物和玩具的數量框會加上背景和陰影, 外觀的物品和套裝標籤會加上陰影.
- [字體] 更新字體時會跳過暴雪框架回傳的秘密對齊值, 例如失控提示, 避免污染和報錯.
- 更新了 LibRangeCheck-3.0 函式庫. GUID 為秘密值時改用單位做快取, WoW Forever 和至暗之夜上的距離檢測可以正常工作.
- [世界地圖] 更新了正式服和 WoW Forever 的迷霧去除資料.
- [美化外觀] WoW Forever 角色聲望頁的交戰、標記為未使用和追蹤聲望核取方塊會留在側邊欄裡.
- [美化外觀] WoW Forever 的角色模型背景不再被移除.
- [美化外觀] Auctionator 移除錯誤回報連結後, 皮膚不再因此報錯.

# 버전: 4.25
2026/11/07 Released
## ✳️ 신규 사항
- [스킨] WoW Forever 파티 찾기(LFGListingFrame) 스킨을 추가했습니다. 등록, 찾아보기, 누구 목록 프레임과 측면 탭에 그림자가 생기고, 등록 화면의 텍스트, 버튼, 활동 목록이 WindTools 글꼴 스타일을 사용합니다. 파티 찾기 스위치로 제어합니다.

# Версия: 4.25
2026/11/07 Релиз
## ✳️ Новые
- [Скины] Добавлен скин для поиска группы в WoW Forever (LFGListingFrame). Окна создания заявки, просмотра и списка игроков, а также их боковые вкладки получают тени, а тексты, кнопки и список занятий используют шрифт WindTools. Управляется переключателем «Поиск группы».
- [Скины] Добавлен скин для социального интерфейса (SocialUIFrame). Основное окно, вкладки и боковые окна получают тени, а BattleTag, кнопки и заголовки списков используют шрифт WindTools.
- [Список друзей] Карточки друзей и раздела «Недавние союзники» в WoW Forever теперь используют значки статуса, значки игры, цвета клиента и класса, уровень, местоположение и шрифты. У Forever есть собственный значок игры.
- [Дополнительная панель предметов] Добавлены группы предметов WoW Forever: зелья, эликсиры, настои, свитки, еда, бинты и утилиты. Эти списки загружаются только в WoW Forever. Новые профили Forever используют их на панелях предметов.
- [Осмотр предметов] Добавлены данные чар WoW Forever. Они загружаются только в WoW Forever. Данные чар основной версии остаются на стандартном клиенте.
- [Фреймы юнитов] Наложение рассеивания теперь работает на рамках группы и рейда в WoW Forever.

- [Скины] Скин Plumber больше не вызывает ошибку в WoW Forever, если страница дополнения не загружена.
